HEADER: Init +5; Senses Darkvision 90 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +28
DEFENSE: AC 28, touch 13; flat-footed 23 (+15 natural, +5 dex, -2 size)
Immune bleed, curse, daze, lightning, nauseating, sickening, stun
OFFENSE: Special Attacks Fists of Lightning and Thunder, Heave, Impale, Thunderbolt
STATISTICS: Str 36, Dex 20, Con 34, Int 6, Wis 18, Cha 8
Feats Alertness, Charge Through, Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Overrun, Multiattack, Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (Bite)
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Beatdown (ex) Whenever struck by a melee attack, as an attack of opportunity, the kuza beast will return one claw strike at (+32) 2d8+26 points of damage.

Counter Magic (su) Whenever struck by a spell, the kuza beast will cast Burst as an immediate action as long as he has MP and is not unable to cast it like the status effect silence. This can only be used once per round.

Heave (ex) Once every 1d4 rounds, the kuza beast can throw a grabbed opponent of Large or smaller size into the air by making a successful grapple check; once thrown, the opponent takes 2d6 points of falling damage, plus an additional 1d6 points of damage for each size category smaller than Large the opponent is (for example, a Medium-sized creature would be 1 category smaller than Large, & therefore would take 3d6 falling damage); this is a standard action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
Impale (ex) When charging, a kuza beast deals double damage with horns.

Fists of Lightning and Thunder (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds, a kuza beast can cause its natural attacks to do either lightning or thunder damage (caster's choice). A lightning attack deals an additional 3d6 points of lightning damage, and the resulting flash blinds the target for 2d6 rounds, a successful Fortitude save (DC 23) negates the blindness. A thunder attack deals an additional 3d6 points of non-elemental damage, and the resulting thunderclap deafens the target for 2d6 rounds, a successful Fortitude save (DC 23) negates the deafness. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

Thunderbolt (su) Once every 1d3 rounds, a kuza beast can discharge a large lightning storm within 120 ft. and in a 40-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 10d6 points of lightning damage and are inflicted with Static status effect for 1d4 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 23) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
